{{Alchemy}}{{Alchemy recipes}}

'''''Forever'' alchemy recipes''' can be learned by players who have chosen [[Alchemy]] as one of their two primary professions during {{g|forever}}. There are a great number of new or updated recipes from [[Classic alchemy recipes|Classic]].

Alchemy is useful at all levels and pairs well with [[Herbalism]] so the alchemist can gather their own reagents, as most recipes require herbs. Alchemy is also profitable, as dungeoneers and raiders will always want the consumable elixirs, flasks, and potions that alchemists can make.

==Notable changes==
Standard healing potions ([[Minor Healing Potion]] through [[Major Healing Potion]]) are now crafted by First Aid.

There are three [[Legacy Challenges]] for raising Alchemy skill, each worth one [[Legacy Point]]:
# [[Journeyman Alchemist]] (150)
# [[Expert Alchemist]] (225)
# [[Artisan Alchemist]] (300)

The two standard tradeskill Legacy Perks affect Alchemy: [[Working Overtime (legacy talent)]] and [[Dedicated Study]].

Alchemists can provide three [[camping]] perks:
# [[Mana Well]] (20 skill; +[[MP5]])
# [[Fermenter]] (140 skill; +MP5, reagent crafting)
# [[Alchemy Laboratory (Camping)]] (300 skill; +MP5, recipe crafting)

Many new recipes are sold by [[Nina Surefire]] at the [[Azeroth Commerce Authority]] or [[Apothecary Durelle]] at [[Durotar Supply and Logistics]] in exchange for [[Merchant's Favor]].

At 300 skill, characters can purchase the [[Alchemy Certification]] from ACA or DS&L vendors for 1000 [[Merchant's Favor]] and gain the {{title|the Alchemist}} title.
